# Combat Ruin

Type: Structure | Internal ID: CombatRuin01 | Location: Meadows | Resources: Bone fragments, ,, Feathers | Inhabitants: Skeleton

# Introduction

Combat Ruins are Points of interest found in the Meadows biome. They look like a wooden battle arena.

## Resources

In the central arena there are an Evil bone pile and up to two Bone fragments.
There is a chest hidden under the wood platform, on the opposite side of the main entrance. It contains one Wooden mace, one Torch and 1 to 3 Feathers.

Categorias: Points of interest
